vlm.face_critique: Face loses photographic definition; features and beard appear flattened and blurry compared to concept.
vlm.secondary_critique: Crown arches are warped and muddy, while scepter, orb, and base plaque text lack crisp definition.
vlm.back_critique: Cape and hair form a solid silhouette, though back textures and ermine spots are heavily simplified.
aesthetic_flaws: Muddy texture seams on cape and plinth
